topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe this is happening. Just when everything was finally falling into place, you drop this bombshell. All the memories we’ve built together, all the times we promised to stick through everything—what does it mean now? Moving across the country? Great, just what I needed. I guess plans change, and people change, but to think it was you... You’re supposed to be the one constant in all this chaos. How are we supposed to just pick up and continue like nothing’s different? It’s easy to say we’ll stay in touch, but the reality is going to be so much harder. I feel like I just got the rug pulled out from under me.
